event.quote: cough for about three weeks now with night sweats
event.text: Have you had any fever, and does the cough produce any sputum or blood?
event.why: Fever and hemoptysis are key features that help distinguish serious pulmonary infections like TB from other causes of chronic cough.

event.text: I recommend an in-person visit today (urgent care, a clinic offering TB testing, or your local public health clinic) — mention your TB exposure risk when you book or arrive so they can use a mask and infection precautions. Three weeks of cough with night sweats and unexplained weight loss needs a chest x-ray and sputum testing that messaging can't provide. If you cough up blood, have chest pain or trouble breathing, go to an emergency department now. A Counsel clinician can stay involved in this thread, but please don't delay today's visit.
